name_reason: Current name 'status_clear_holy_word' is a misnomer. fd2-knowledge KB spell id 0x19 (25) = 行動術 ('act again'), effect '使行動過的人再次行動' (let a unit that already acted act again); there is no 'holy word' spell at 0x19 (神恩術 'divine grace' is a heal spell, unrelated). Body confirms semantics: tests runtime_char flags bit-7 = the 'acted' bit (types.h +0x05 bit7=acted), hits only units that have acted, and clears bit-7 to grant the re-action. 'status_clear' obscures the defining behavior and 'holy_word' is fabricated/misleading. Propose fd2_execute_reactivate_spell_id_25: keeps fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> + meaningful decimal spell id 25 (=0x19, baked into body & dispatch table index 0x19), matching sibling fd2_execute_offensive_single_target_spell_id_9. Rename NOT applied this stage (sites: protos.h:147 decl, spelleff.c def, btltab.c:358 table entry 0x19).
purpose: Worker for spell id 0x19 (25) = 行動術 ('act again'): clears the target's 'acted' flag bit so a unit that already acted this turn may act again, and awards XP per re-enabled unit.
logic_summary: Reset data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx=0; deduct caster MP for spell 0x19; play per-target impact (fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target) + status-overlay-flicker (fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker) animations keyed to id 0x19. For each target_id in target_id_array[0..num_targets-1]: rc=&runtime_char_array[target_id]; if (rc->flags & 0x80)==0 (unit has not acted) -> fd2_show_miss_indicator; else clear the acted bit (rc->flags &= 0x7F), status_value=rc->status_flags_block[0] (level), +0x1E if 8<job_id<0x19 (intermediate class), pending_xp_credit += status_value*8. Then fd2_composite_battle_frame(0); if aoe/fx-queue idx != 0 -> fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). Explicit RET at 0x22CBE. Disasm verified: TEST [EAX+0x5],0x80 (flags), AND [EAX+0x5],0x7F, MOVZX [EAX+0x21] (level), MOVZX [EAX+0x20] (job_id), SHL EDX,3 (x8), ADD [0x53EC8],EDX.

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Caster's runtime-char unit id; forwarded to fd2_deduct_caster_mp and the two animation calls.

params.name: num_targets
params.semantics: Number of selected targets; loop bound and 3rd arg to the impact/overlay animations.

params.name: target_id_array
params.semantics: Byte array of target unit ids; each entry indexes runtime_char_array. Read as target_id_array[iter] (asm MOVZX from [ESI+EBX]).

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are mutation of runtime_char flags + global XP accumulator + on-screen animations.

comment_original_issue: Source comment (and Ghidra plate) identified the spell as STATUS-CLEAR 'holy word', which is wrong: spell 0x19 is 行動術 (re-activate / act-again). The misnomer also collides conceptually with 神恩術 (a heal spell). Technical details (offsets, 8x XP, asm) were accurate.
notes: Disasm fully cross-checked against src (faithful Layer-2 equivalent; no logic change). Dispatch verified: table @ 0x51D01 byte +0x64 = 04 2c 02 00 = 0x00022C04 (entry index 0x19=25); also btltab.c:358 entry 0x19. types.h confirms runtime_char.flags @+0x05 bit7=acted, job_id @+0x20, status_flags_block[0]=level @+0x21. fd2-knowledge: spell 25 = 行動術 '使行動過的人再次行動'. Name rename only RECORDED (Stage 2 applies across protos.h/btltab.c).
